title: Buttercup Neural Knowledge Extraction
definition: The process of extracting latent knowledge from a neural network's internal representations and using it for training domain-specific adapters.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it as pulling out the information a neural network has learned and using it to make a new teacher more knowledgeable.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Buttercup neural knowledge extraction involves analyzing the internal representations of a neural network to identify patterns related to a specific domain. These patterns are then used to create a LoRA adapter that can be transferred to another model, improving its performance on questions related to the domain.
difficulty_levels.expert: Buttercup neural knowledge extraction is a technique for identifying task-specific patterns in a neural network's internal representations. These patterns are then used to create LoRA adapters that can be transferred between models, allowing for efficient domain-specific fine-tuning.

extra_fields.insight: Buttercup neural knowledge extraction allows us to leverage a model's internal representations to create domain-specific adapters for efficient fine-tuning.
